intro: The nearest D-SAP centre to Aundh is our head office in New Sangvi, about {{commute:aundh#km}} km away, just across the river.

sections.heading: Getting there from Aundh

body.text: Cross the Rajiv Gandhi Bridge to Sangvi Phata, then follow Old Sangvi Road and the Pimple Gurav-Navi Sangvi Road to Krishna Nagar Road Number 2.

body: The time shown is for clear roads, so leave a little earlier on weekday afternoons.

body.text: Students from Vidyanchal High School and AW Sindhu Vidya Bhavan in Aundh already study with us.
Aundh sits on the Pune side of the river and our head office on the Pimpri-Chinchwad side, but one bridge makes them neighbours. For a family in Aundh, that short crossing is the whole trip.
Aundh students join the two-year programme after Class 10, or the one-year programme in Class 12, in batches of at most {{fact:batch.size}}.

questions.q: Is there a D-SAP centre in Aundh?

a.text: No. The nearest is our head office in New Sangvi, about {{commute:aundh#km}} km away across the Rajiv Gandhi Bridge.

questions.q: Is the Wakad branch an option?
questions.a: It is farther from Aundh. The [New Sangvi head office](page:centre-sangvi-head-office) is the shorter trip.

questions.q: When should my child leave home?
questions.a: Classes start at {{fact:batch.timings#start}}. Plan the trip with time to spare, since afternoon traffic varies.
